note: What a server sends to set how long until one of a unit's spells is ready. The header names the unit this is about.

bits.name: speakWhenReady
bits.note: Set where the unit says something once the wait is over. Clear in everything observed.

bits.name: summonerSpell
bits.note: Set where the slot is a summoner slot rather than one of the unit's own. Clear in everything observed.

fields.name: timeLeft
fields.note: How long is left, in seconds. A client counts down from it on the slot.

fields.name: outOf
fields.note: The length the client shows that remainder against, in seconds.

bits.name: speakWhenReady
bits.note: Set where the unit says something once the wait is over. Clear in everything observed.

bits.name: summonerSpell
bits.note: Set where the slot is a summoner slot rather than one of the unit's own. Clear in everything observed. A client given it on slot 0 still puts the wait on slot 0, so it does not move the slot into the summoner range.

fields.name: timeLeft
fields.note: How long is left, in seconds. A client counts down from it.

fields.name: outOf
fields.note: The length the client shows that remainder against, in seconds: 20 left out of 40 shows the wait half run.
